sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('21b095d1-5ade-43e9-9114-30fbfb2331c9', 'a2a8615b-a27e-4ab2-ae4c-592bbf4643c0') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
